script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

Title: A New Leaf

INT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

The bustling halls of the office building are filled with employees scurrying about, phones in hand, and laptops on shoulders.

INT. IT DEPARTMENT - DAY

MALCOLM, a mid-level IT manager, sits in his cubicle, staring at his computer screen with frustration. He's been passed over for a promotion for the third time in a row. Across the room, AMANDA, a young and ambitious IT analyst, types away at her own computer, focused and determined.

MALCOLM
(sighs)
(under his breath)
Another day, another dollar.

AMANDA
Malcolm? Is everything okay?

MALCOLM
(looks up, forcing a smile)
Oh, yes, Amanda. Just having a little trouble with this new software update. You know how it is.

AMANDA
I know how it feels. I've been working on the same project for weeks. But we'll get through it together.

Malcolm nods, but he can't shake the feeling that Amanda is a threat to his position.

INT. COFFEE BREAK ROOM - LATER

Malcolm sits alone at a table, sipping on his lukewarm coffee. The break room is filled with the sounds of chatter and laughter.

Suddenly, EMMA, the HR representative, enters the room, holding a stack of papers.

EMMA
(smiling)
Hey, Malcolm. I see you're enjoying your coffee break.

MALCOLM
(nervously)
Oh, hi, Emma. Yes, just trying to get through the day.

EMMA
(sets down the papers)
I have some good news for you. It looks like you've been selected for the IT management training program. Congratulations!

Malcolm is shocked and elated. He jumps up from his seat, thanking Emma profusely.

INT. IT DEPARTMENT - DAY

Malcolm returns to his cubicle, beaming with pride. Amanda looks up from her computer as he approaches.

AMANDA
(smiling)
Congratulations, Malcolm. I'm so happy for you.

MALCOLM
(gratefully)
Thank you, Amanda. I couldn't have done it without your support.

Amanda smiles, but Malcolm can see a glint of disappointment in her eyes.

INT. OFFICE BUILDING - NIGHT

The office building is dark and empty, except for Malcolm, who is still working late. He's reviewing reports and preparing for his new role.

Suddenly, he hears a noise coming from the server room. He grabs a flashlight and heads towards the sound.

INT. SERVER ROOM - NIGHT

Malcolm enters the dimly lit room and sees AMANDA huddled over a server, trying to fix an issue.

AMANDA
(startled)
Malcolm! What are you doing here?

MALCOLM
(relieved)
I heard the noise and wanted to make sure everything was okay.

AMANDA
(smiling)
I've got it under control. I just needed a little extra time to troubleshoot.

Malcolm helps Amanda finish the task, and they work together in a way they never have before.

INT. IT DEPARTMENT - DAY

The following day, Malcolm approaches Amanda with a sheepish look on his face.

MALCOLM
Amanda, I want to apologize for my behavior towards you. I've been feeling insecure about my position, and I took it out on you. I'm sorry.

Amanda looks at him, surprised but understanding.

AMANDA
(smiling)
It's okay, Malcolm. We all have our moments. But I forgive you. Let's move forward and work together to make our department the best it can be.

Malcolm nods, grateful for Amanda's forgiveness.

INT. OFFICE BUILDING - END OF DAY

The office building is empty once again, except for Malcolm, who is packing up his things for the day. He takes a deep breath, feeling a sense of peace and contentment.

MALCOLM
(to himself)
A new leaf. That's what I need to be.

Fade to black.

End screenplay.
